CSE - Abort Script Execution.vi

Owning Palette: CSE Script Processor

The VI aborts execution of a running CSE script. In addition, the VI can be used to check up an abort trigger in a given CSE instance context.

Click the parameters for more information

 

CSE RefNum is a reference number for a CSE instance that contains a parsed CSE script. CSE - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
action is an optional parameter that specifies an operation to perform:

0triggerThe VI sets an abort trigger in the specified context and contexts of all the scripts involved in a call chain of the referenced script (a case when scripts call another scripts). It causes termination of execution of the referenced script as well as all the scripts involved in its call chain. This operation executes asynchronously with running script(s). This is default value.
1resetThe VI resets an abort trigger in the specified context and returns its new state (FALSE).
2checkThe VI returns the current state of an abort trigger in the specified context.
3flipThe VI resets an abort trigger in the specified context and returns the previous state of the trigger.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup CSE RefNum is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CSE RefNum.
triggered returns a state of an abort trigger.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
